title: TTS Retry, Resume, And Audio Status Repair
description: Improve transient TTS error handling and reading audio resumability so timeout/PENDING items can be retried without regenerating text content.

success: Timeouts and retryable HTTP statuses use bounded backoff retries.
Reading audio generation preserves successful chunks and can resume failed or pending materials.
A service/API or documented operational path exists to repair stuck audio status.
verification: Fake TTS tests for timeout, empty URL, partial chunk success, and retry success
